text:
Riya (People Ops): Quick heads-up 1 Jordan starts Monday. I drafted a compact manager+HR checklist focused on week0 clarity. Please flag gaps.

Alex (Eng Manager): Nice. Main goal: get Jordan a small "first-issue" to merge by EOW so they touch the full loop.

Priya (HR): I'll use a brief 30/60/90: each window = 2 outcomes + 1 skill focus. Day3 benefits overview + day0 payroll packet.

Sam (IT): Need laptop preference + shipping addr. Also decide: enforce MFA day0 or day1?

Jordan (New Hire): MacBook Air M2 is perfect. Address same as offer. MFA day0 works for me.

OnboardBot: Welcome Jordan! :tada: Created onboarding checklist: device order, Slack + GH invites, payroll forms, security training. Reminders scheduled.

Alex (Eng Manager): Manager checklist (compact):
- Day0: 30-min intro + env setup with IT/buddy.
- Day1: join standup + pick onboarding issue.
- Day2: pair on CI/runbook.
- Day3: benefits + payroll check with HR.
- EOW: 30-min sync to set 30/60/90 and capture blockers.

Priya (HR): Paperwork checklist: tax forms, direct deposit (send day0); benefits email day3; compliance training link (complete by EOW).

Sam (IT): Access provisioning snippet I'm doing: ```
- Okta + MFA
- Slack (eng, people-ops)
- GitHub org (onboarding repo)
- Jira project: platform
- VPN & wiki
```
I'll post invites after device ordered.

Alex (Eng Manager): EOW success criteria = joined Slack, dev env functional, onboarding PR opened or merged, compliance training started. If blockers remain escalate to Riya.

Riya (People Ops): Perfect. Alex, please send the calendar invites and create the onboarding issue. Sam, please expedite device if shipping ETA > 48h. Priya will send payroll packet day0. Thanks team! :thumbsup:
